statement_notes.justification: The lemma turns the higher-order blueprint into a total estimator, retains the direct weighted contrast-approximation residual of order \(h^\gamma\) in the complete score decomposition, and exposes every bias and variance term needed for rate optimization.
statement_notes.gap: Published higher-order CATE constructions motivate the form, but this proof is specialized to the exact uniform law and verifies both corrected moments, the retained \(O(h^\gamma)\) score residual, and stabilization on the present Bernoulli class.
statement_notes.consumer: The bounded-overlap theorem uses this inequality, with the retained residual absorbed by its existing \(h^\gamma\) approximation term, to derive the nuisance elbow and all-\(n\) upper rate.
